purpose: Curator proposal: rights-checked photographs for the three study traditions, shown identically in the 2D and 3D conditions as captioned figures (3:2 slot, 768 px long edge). Not craft facts; nothing here is published until curators accept it. Never written into content/traditions/*.json by this pass.

licencePolicy.tier1: public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA (any version)
licencePolicy.tier2: CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-SA, and museum terms that explicitly permit free non-commercial, educational or scholarly display online (V&A non-commercial terms). ND licences only if shown uncropped.
licencePolicy.rejected: all rights reserved, unclear or missing licence, 'fair use', terms forbidding online display, licence laundering, watermarked or stock images, AI-generated images

identificationRule: An image counts for a tradition only if its own record names the tradition or its place (Ajrakh/Ajrak; Sanganer/Sanganeri; Machilipatnam/Masulipatam/Pedana). Recognition by eye does not count. Hedges in the record are kept in the caption. Reading Dhamanka as Dhamadka is the project's inference and is shown in brackets.
balancingRule: Same kinds for every tradition, one photo per kind per tradition, each attached to a concept in the same section for all three. A kind missing for any tradition is dropped for all three, and a kind whose images are not comparable in medium and salience is held back for all three. Result: textile only (one V&A whole-object studio photograph per tradition, context section). Process and tool are dropped because Machilipatnam Kalamkari has no eligible image of either; place is held in reserve because the three images are not comparable.
displayCap: Every study photo is served at most 768 px on the long edge, with no larger srcset step, because the V&A terms allow no more; one cap for all photos so that no tradition's images look sharper.

statusMeaning.proposed: survived research and verification and fills a balanced kind slot
statusMeaning.reserve: verified and usable, held back by the balance rule (other image chosen for the slot, or kind dropped), or carried over unchecked from the earlier pass
statusMeaning.rejected: did not survive verification, or superseded; reasons given
